_comment: Lightning Phase 12 load, stress and chaos (spec Phase 20, database side). The migration creates no function, no table and no column and alters nothing: every change is an asserted substitution into a body PokerIQ-Production already carries, so this fragment promises nothing new. fn_lightning_match_and_form measures pass_time_budget_ms from the end of its first plan, so a pool whose plan alone outlasts the budget (about 3,000 eligible players and up) is still dealt; fn_cash_cluster_commit_lightning and fn_cash_cluster_abort_pending_off take the Cluster's live seats FOR SHARE in seat-id order before entering them into the pool, so a departure racing a conversion can no longer leave a pool session on a departed seat that refuses every later reversion. Proven by scripts/dev/test-lightning-phase12-load-chaos.sh.
